Election Commission Row: Opposition Demands Action Over SIR Report

Following a report alleging internal disagreements within the Election Commission regarding the "SIR" process, opposition leader Rahul Gandhi has sharply criticized Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar. Gandhi called the alleged disagreements "treason" and demanded that Gyanesh Kumar be sent to jail. The report claims two Election Commissioners had objected to the SIR process.
